purpose: Release gate for familiar local-library workflows. Action counts exclude typing and playback time.

tasks.expected: Movies and TV are direct visible destinations; neither requires a promotional row or sign-in.
Switching between Movies and TV keeps each profile's saved view and sort choice.
Search is reachable from the visible header and accepts a local title query.
Open then close details restores focus to the originating library card and preserves its rail position.
A saved per-profile view and sort are returned after the local database is reopened.
Selecting a local title resumes through the existing playback flow.
Audio and subtitle track selection remains a visible in-player control when delivered.
tasks.evidence: Issue #30 owns the implementation and acceptance.
